name: Ditto
abilities: Clones act independently and re-merge at will
weaknesses: Cannot revert until all clones are close together (drains the Omnitrix)
Clones can be forced back together
In OS all clones shared pain and death
Vulnerable to electricity and extreme cold
summary: A small black-and-white Splixson who splits into an endless crowd of himself - great for numbers, terrible in a straight fight.
traits: Sensory nodes on arms and waist store the cloning DNA
OS clones shared pain; OV clones do not (retcon)
About the height of a human child
notableFeats: Beat Dr. Animo's Lepidopterran/Splixson hybrid army (Divided We Stand)
Saved Mrs. Fang and defeated Mr. Beck (Ready to Rumble)
Fought Eon as 16-year-old Ben in his 11-year-old body (Ben Again)
Fought the Pretty Boy clones and chased Ma Vreedle (O Mother, Where Art Thou?)

appearances.designNotes: White skin, black-and-white head, black shoulders, three head fins, black overall-like clothes, green eyes with light-green shine, original Omnitrix on the forehead.

Smaller and stubbier; white fins with side fins joined to the eyes, cheek whiskers, sharper fingers, nodes moved to shoulders/wrists, cat-like toes. 16-year-old wears a green jumpsuit with black patches and a black node belt; 11-year-old keeps a black suit. Omnitrix on forehead.

scoring.rationale: Unlimited clones cover ground and swarm weaker foes, but each Ditto is small and weak, the group can't revert until regathered, and in OS every clone shared damage.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked) or Ultimate Alien (intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
OV 'Ben Again': 16-year-old Ben's mind in 11-year-old Ben's body used the 11-year-old design (counted as ben-11-ov).
Also used by Ken (Ken 10) - not counted.
